paper_title: New Limit on Dark Photon Kinetic Mixing in the 0.2-1.2 $\boldsymbolμ$eV Mass Range From the Dark E-Field Radio Experiment
notes: Paper reports a new measured 95% C.L. exclusion on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon over 0.21-1.24 ueV (50-300 MHz) from the Dark E-Field Radio experiment at UC Davis. The actual limit curve (Fig. 11) is highly jagged, tracking shielded-room resonant modes, ranging between 6e-15 (best) and 6e-13 (worst). No numerical table is provided; the two emitted points encode the CONSERVATIVE envelope (weakest limit, 6e-13) across the full mass range. The true limit dips as low as 6e-15 at resonances. Local DM density fixed at rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (450 TeV/m^3). Future 0.3-25 GHz runs are projections only and not included. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.55, 2))
